paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani thum ni a David leh amite Ziklag atun un, Amalekte'n simlam leh Ziklag khua ana sim khin uh. Ziklag khua ana sual ua, mei in ana hal uhi.
heading: Amalekte Toh Kidouna
english: When David and his men had come to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made a raid on the South and on Ziklag, and had struck Ziklag and burned it with fire,

paite: Numeite leh khua a om peuhmah aneu-alian sal in aman ua, kuamah that lou a pi in apaipih khinta uhi.
english: and had taken captive the women and all who were in it, both small and great. They didn’t kill any, but carried them off and went their way.

paite: David leh amite khua ava tun un, ngai in, ana kangsiang khinta hi. Azite, atapate leh atanute uh sal in ana man khinta uhi.
english: When David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, their sons, and their daughters were taken captive.

paite: David leh akiang a omte'n aw suah in kah leng kap zou nawn lou khop in akap uhi.
english: Then David and the people who were with him lifted up their voice and wept until they had no more power to weep.

paite: David zite nih: Jezreel mi Ahinoam leh Karmel mi Nabal zi Abigail leng sal a pi in a-om uhi.
english: David’s two wives were taken captive, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

paite: Michih atapate uh leh atánute uh ziak a lungkham in amah suang a den ding thu agen ziak un, David alungzing mahmah hi. Himahleh David bel. TOUPA a Pathian ah akihihhat hi.
english: David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because the souls of all the people were grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters; but David strengthened himself in Yahweh his God.

paite: David in Ahimelek tapa siampu Abiathar kiang ah, "Siampu puanak hon va laksak dih ve," achi hi. Abiathar in David siampu puanak ava laksak hi.
english: David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, “Please bring the ephod here to me.” Abiathar brought the ephod to David.

paite: David in, "Hiaite delh leng ka pha lai diam?" chi in TOUPA adong hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Delh in, na pha ngeingei ding, na la nawn vek ding," achi hi.
english: David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “If I pursue after this troop, will I overtake them?” He answered him, “Pursue, for you will surely overtake them, and will without fail recover all.”

paite: Huchi in David, amah leh akiang a mi zaguk toh akuankhia a, Besor lui ava tung ua, ami nutsiatte uh huai ah a-om uhi.
english: So David went, he and the six hundred men who were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those who were left behind stayed.

paite: David in adelh zel a, amah leh mi zalite toh, mi zanihte'n abah tak ziak un Besor lui akan zou kei uhi,
english: But David pursued, he and four hundred men; for two hundred stayed behind, who were so faint that they couldn’t go over the brook Besor.

paite: Gamlak ah Aigupta mi amu ua, David kiang ah api ua, tanghou apia ua, ama'n ane a, tui adawnsak uhi.
english: They found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he ate; and they gave him water to drink.

paite: Theipi beu them khat leh grep gah phoukeu bawm nih apia uhi. Hiaite anekleh ahong halh nawn a; ni thum leh zan thum an ne lou leh tui dawn lou lah ahita ngal a.
english: They gave him a piece of a cake of figs and two clusters of raisins. When he had eaten, his spirit came again to him; for he had eaten no bread, and drank no water for three days and three nights.

paite: David in akiang ah, "Kua na hia? Koi a kipan a hong na hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Aigupta gam tangval, Amalek mi sikha ka hi. Ni thum ahita a, ka chi anat ziak in ka pu in hon nusia maimah hi.
english: David asked him, “To whom do you belong? Where are you from?” He said, “I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days ago I got sick.

paite: Kereth sim gam leh Judah sim gamte ka sim ua, Kaleb sim gam leng ka sim ua, huchi in Ziklag khua leng ka hal uh," achi hi.
english: We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Judah, and on the South of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.”

paite: David in akiang ah, "Huaite omna ah na hon pisuk thei diam?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hon that lou ding leh ka pu khut a hon pe nawn lou ding in Pathian min lou in ka kiang ah kichiam inla, huchi in huaite omna ah ka hon pisuk ding," achi hi.
english: David said to him, “Will you bring me down to this troop?” He said, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me and not deliver me up into the hands of my master, and I will bring you down to this troop.”

paite: Apisukleh, ngai in, Philistia gam leh Judah gam a gallak tampi alak ziak un ankuang alui ua, ane un adawn ua mun teng ah ana om dalh phengphung uhi.
english: When he had brought him down, behold, they were spread around over all the ground, eating, drinking, and dancing, because of all the great plunder that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.

paite: Huchi in David in nitum a pan zingsang nitaklam tan in amau asual hi. Tangval zali sangawngsau tung a tuang a taikekte kia lou ngal kuamah dam a suakta himhim a-om kei uh.
english: David struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day. Not a man of them escaped from there, except four hundred young men who rode on camels and fled.

paite: David in Amalek mite puakmang tengteng ala nawn vek a, David in azi nihte leng ahunkheta hi.
english: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and David rescued his two wives.

paite: Huchi in aneu-alian in, atapate uh, atanute uh, agallak uh leh athil lak himhim bangmah tan anei kei ua, David in alaksak nawn vek hi.
english: There was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither plunder, nor anything that they had taken. David brought them all back.

paite: David in belamhon leh ganhon tengteng ala a, gan dangte ma ah ahawl ua, "Hiaite David gallak ahi," achi uhi.
english: David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drove before those other livestock, and said, “This is David’s plunder.”

paite: Mi zanih abah ziak ua David zuizou nawn lou a Besor lui a a-omsakte uh kiang ah David ava tung hi. Amau David dawn ding leh akiang a omte dawn ding in apawtkhia uh. Mite kiang atun in David in amaute chibai abuk hi.
english: David came to the two hundred men, who were so faint that they could not follow David, whom also they had made to stay at the brook Besor; and they went out to meet David, and to meet the people who were with him. When David came near to the people, he greeted them.

paite: David kiang a hohte lak a migiloute leh Belial mi teng in adawng ua, "I kiang ua ahong tel louh ziak un gallak thil i va lak nawn himhimte amau i pe kei ding uh. Api ua apaitheihna ding un azite chiat uh leh atate chiat uh ahihleh api uh i phal ding uh, achi uhi.
english: Then all the wicked men and worthless fellows of those who went with David answered and said, “Because they didn’t go with us, we will not give them anything of the plunder that we have recovered, except to every man his wife and his children, that he may lead them away and depart.”

paite: David in, "Unaute aw, TOUPA eite hon kembitpa'n ahon piakleh eite dou dia hong kuante i khut ua hon pepa thilte huchi in hih kei un.
english: Then David said, “Do not do so, my brothers, with that which Yahweh has given to us, who has preserved us, and delivered the troop that came against us into our hand.

paite: Kua'n ahia hiai thu a na thu uh zui ding? Kidouna a hohte tan bangmah van veng a na omte'n leng atan sam ding uh ahi; kibang vek a tan ding ahi," achi hi.
english: Who will listen to you in this matter? For as his share is who goes down to the battle, so shall his share be who stays with the baggage. They shall share alike.”

paite: Huai ni a pan tuni tan in Israelte a dia thupiak leh dan thuseh ding in abawlta hi.
english: It was so from that day forward that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.

paite: David, Ziklag khua atun in, gallak khenkhat, hiai, TOUPA melmate lak a gallak, nang a dia thilpiak, chi in Judah upate, alawmte ngei kiang ah, gallak khenkhat akhak hi.
english: When David came to Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, “Behold, a present for you from the plunder of Yahweh’s enemies.”

paite: Bethel a omte kiang ah, Ramoth sim a omte kiang ah, Jattir a omte kiang ah,
english: He sent it to those who were in Bethel, to those who were in Ramoth of the South, to those who were in Jattir,

paite: Aroer a omte kiang ah, Siphmoth a omte kiang ah, Eshtemoa a omte kiang ah;
english: to those who were in Aroer, to those who were in Siphmoth, to those who were in Eshtemoa,

paite: Rakal a omte kiang ah, Jerahmeel a omte kiang ah, Kente a omte kiang ah;
english: to those who were in Racal, to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, to those who were in the cities of the Kenites,

paite: Hormah a omte kiang ah, Bor-ashan a omte kiang ah, Athak a omte kiang ah;
english: to those who were in Hormah, to those who were in Borashan, to those who were in Athach,

paite: Hebron a omte kiang ah, David leh amite tatna mun tengteng kiang ah.
english: to those who were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men used to stay.
